history.equivalence: seal 1d Codex round 12: the walks over links (graph check, support verdict, required-component refit, verifier) find a peak's master as _make_peak_params does (equality) instead of by string spelling (_link_masters). Round 13: run_fit's graph check also refuses two ids equal as values (1, 1.0, true), as /api/fit already did, so a link names one peak; round 14: an id whose parameter names Python would normalise (NFKC) is refused. No fitted number moves; only a constrain_to spelled differently from its master's id (1.0 or true for id 1), which the page never sends, now follows its master. Evidence: all 328 seal-1b records validate unchanged (support follows its root); tests/test_seal_1d_compare.py equal-id tests.

LA unit: _convolve_same_fixed_order sums only the kernel taps that reach the 'same' window. Every returned entry receives the same terms in the same order, so no bit moves (tests/test_la_deterministic.py: 4,000 random grids and kernels against the every-tap form, exact equality; both off-by-one ranges fail it).
